notes: The manuscript is a clipped handwritten mathematical note in three prose blocks. The original whole image measures 1688 by 2366 pixels. No author page number or date is visible. H’s page 6 marker is treated as editorial pagination, not imported as ink.

Author claim: for a ring on X, M and N are the K^0 and K^1 sheaves attached to the additive champ of projective modules with a partly ambiguous abbreviated qualification. The construction attributed to Mme Sinh is said to supply a Picard champ pinned by M,N and hence a canonical section of the middle term. This report does not verify that construction or its consequence.

Author claim: the preceding objects have evident functorialities in M,N,X. The uncertainty on fonctorialités concerns the compressed ink ending; it is not a mathematical doubt attributed to the author.

Author questions: whether the exact triangle and exact sequence are known to the named people (Quillen, Breen, Illusie), and whether they know higher variants. The final parenthesis proposes obtaining them through n-champs of Picard that are not necessarily strict. Explicit author question marks and the words Question and pourrait are preserved.

The mathematical roles of the two label references, the alphabet of A and the middle-term P/F prompted targeted ink inspections. Those inspections are textual readings, not proof checks. No other page, proof source, external transcription or web source was consulted. No OCR was used.

The missing closing parenthesis after the middle term is not supplied from expected balance. Both the right-edge N and the next line beginning de (*) were inspected. Similarly, the absent comma after Breen was assessed on both physical sides of that line break.

The small punctuation after the inserted example has a clear upper hooked stroke plus detached tiny components. Comma, semicolon and exclamation remain alternatives because the intentional status of the lowest small component cannot be fixed. This doubt is present in reading.tex.

Isolated tiny marks were also assessed. A small dot above the fused sequence label and two low dots below the end of principe do not occupy the ordinary punctuation baseline and resemble scattered copy flecks. They are not promoted to author punctuation. Their locations are respectively [1244,912,1255,923] and [922,1254,941,1272]. The dot inside the left parenthesis near the triangle label is similarly much lighter than the writing and lies among halo noise; it is not assigned a mathematical role.

The two short black curves beside the inset sheet’s lower left edge and the long copy borders are physical copying impressions, not an author diagram. The two curves are noted in a TeX comment. No author drawing, diagram, display block, marginal note or separate heading/closing of a letter occurs.

C doubts retained: clipped heading/sign/soit/A; projective-module abbreviation; p/par; construction; cancelled du/de; P/F; fonctorialités; T/J; clipped et; fused star; connu/connus; Connaissent/Donnaissent; variantes/variante. C doubts resolved from strokes: fourni, compétences, néc. The inserted punctuation has an additional explicit doubt.

All thirteen crop files were viewed once in numerical order after the whole image and the two halves. A single crop covers the split construction and the nearby verb ending; no part of that crop was enlarged again. Some crops include adjacent context that also settles another listed locus. No already-settled locus was deliberately recropped.
Model metadata is reported using the exposed identity GPT-6 Astra Pro; no lower-level model identifier or effort setting was exposed.

Crop 06 contains the full long word and blank space below rather than the next line’s words, which end farther left. Crop 13 similarly contains the short abbreviation and adjacent blank space. Their surrounding sentence context was already supplied by the half views; no second crop was made.

coverage: The complete page was read against both supplied witnesses, including all agreed words and mathematical signs, first through whole-page layout inspection and then the two full-resolution halves once each. The first paragraph, the small above-line insertion and its guide, the struck short word, the NB paragraph, both questions and the full closing parenthesis were covered. K degrees, A alphabets, all M,N,X occurrences, both starred references, the triangle label, punctuation, quoted adjectives, word endings and n-champs were read from their own ink. All C doubts were either retained with evidence or explicitly resolved. H omits the deletion and insertion state, leaves readable portions of the module qualification unreadable, supplies a closing parenthesis and a comma not visible in the scan, and differs on construction/raisonnement, fourni/fournit and en/les; these and the other confidence/shape differences are individually recorded. The archive 64 is comment-only. No missing author block, margin note, diagram or display was found. No mathematical verification is claimed; checks is intentionally empty.
